INSERT INTO t_phase_one_feedback_cluster_identity_projection( generation_id,source_id,cluster_id,source_channel,logical_channel,function_module,province_code, city_code,region_value,reported_at,identity_scope,identity_type,fingerprint_key_id,fingerprint ) VALUES
(#{row.generationId},#{row.sourceId},#{row.clusterId},#{row.sourceChannel},#{row.logicalChannel}, #{row.functionModule},#{row.provinceCode},#{row.cityCode},#{row.regionValue},#{row.reportedAt}, #{row.identityScope},#{row.identityType},#{row.fingerprintKeyId},#{row.fingerprint})
AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cluster_id=incoming.cluster_id,source_channel=incoming.source_channel, logical_channel=incoming.logical_channel,function_module=incoming.function_module, province_code=incoming.province_code,city_code=incoming.city_code,region_value=incoming.region_value, reported_at=incoming.reported_at,projected_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
